presentation.summary: Adds a Siloscope link to the admin sidebar.
presentation.description_markdown: Adds **Siloscope** under **Plugin Apps** in the admin sidebar. It opens your Siloscope server, the playback history and stats monitor for Silo and Plex.
presentation.setup_markdown: Enter the address you use to open Siloscope in a browser, for example `http://192.168.1.10:8080`, and save. **Siloscope** then appears under **Plugin Apps** in the admin sidebar.

capabilities.description: Opens Siloscope from the admin sidebar.

fields.label: Siloscope URL
fields.description: The address you use to open Siloscope in a browser.
